headline: Vermont soy candles with no synthetic fragrances
body: Pour-by-hand craftsmanship using natural soy wax means zero synthetic fragrances in your home. Handcrafted in Vermont with a transparent supply chain.
rationale: This persona requires explicit factual details to combat greenwashing skepticism. Using specific details like natural soy wax and no synthetic fragrances matches their preference for specific sustainability claims without using vague eco terms.
